fieldData.acrm---key-feature-5-content:
Alerts on answers that need a person

Alert whoever owns an answer by email or in Slack: the clinical director for a safety question, or the billing lead for an insurance plan outside your practice's network.
fieldData.acrm---integration-feature-4:
Scored screeners, and one answer that cannot wait

Northgate Community Mental Health puts the PHQ-9 and GAD-7 inside its adult intake, and both totals are scored on submit. Any answer other than "Not at all" on PHQ-9 item 9, the question about thoughts of self-harm, alerts Dr. Owen Marsh, the clinical director, to call the client that day.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { groupPractice: "I run a group counseling practice and need a therapy intake form for new clients. Ask what brings them in and whether they want telehealth. When they submit, show the clinicians who treat that concern and have an opening, and let them book one on the same screen. Send anyone with no match to Rosa Delgado, our intake coordinator, for a call back.", couplesTherapy: "My couples practice needs an intake where each partner gets a separate link to the same questions, including a rating of the relationship out of 10. Neither partner should be able to open the other's answers. Show the therapist both responses side by side, and open booking for the first joint session only once both forms are in.", teenCounseling: "Build an adolescent intake split between teen and parent. The teen gets a private link with questions about school and sleep, and only the counselor can see those answers. The parent adds family history and signs the consent for treatment. Do not let anyone book the first session until the parent has signed.", communityClinic: "My community mental health clinic needs an adult intake that includes the PHQ-9 and GAD-7. Score both totals when the client submits and show them on the clinician's intake summary. If a client answers anything other than Not at all on PHQ-9 item 9, alert Dr. Owen Marsh, our clinical director, to call them that day." };

acrm---key-feature-4-image.alt: A community clinic's intake scores the PHQ-9 and GAD-7 for four new clients and alerts the clinical director to call the one client who answered item 9 with anything other than Not at all.
